title: Advisory diff-vs-test warning at green cells finish
action: Add an advisory producer at the green-cap path of cells finish: when the checkout has git and the HEAD commit body carries the finishing cell id (the one-commit-per-cell convention; silently skip when it does not), read that commit numstat; when total changed lines exceed a threshold (config key finish.advisory_untested_lines, default 150, value 0 disables — follow existing config get/set plumbing precedent) AND zero changed paths look like tests (path segment test/tests, filename tests.rs, *_test.*, *.test.*), print exactly one advisory line to stderr naming the line count and threshold, and append it to trace.warnings (slot exists — prior producer retired, see finish_support.rs comment near line 568). Never changes exit code or cap outcome; every git failure is silent skip. Unit tests: test-path heuristic table, threshold boundary, disabled-by-zero, missing-git silent skip.

truths: A red or refused finish never gains the advisory (green path only)
Advisory never alters exit code, cap, or JSON success shape beyond trace.warnings
Config 0 disables; git absence is a silent skip
One stderr line, never composited away

trace.outcome: Added a diff-vs-test advisory to cells finish's green-cap path (trace.warnings + one stderr line), config-gated and silent on any git failure
